# CI Calendar — Contact Improvisation Events in Israel

> CI Calendar (ci-events.org) is a free, volunteer-run calendar of Contact Improvisation events in Israel: jams, classes, workshops, courses and festivals. Event organizers and teachers publish their own events, and a volunteer team moderates them. The interface is in Hebrew, with English and Russian translations.

The calendar is a single-page web app that renders in the browser. Event listings are loaded client-side, so a plain HTTP fetch of the home page returns only the app shell.

## Pages

- [Event calendar](https://www.ci-events.org/): Upcoming Contact Improvisation events across Israel, as a list or a calendar view, filterable by region and event type
- [About](https://www.ci-events.org/about): Who runs the project, how it is funded, and how to support it
- [Privacy policy](https://www.ci-events.org/privacy-policy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.ci-events.org/terms-and-conditions)
